title: Conditions of Quotation for a Tier of the Building Automation Service Plans
content:
# Conditions of Quotation for a Tier of the Building Automation Service Plans

**Condition 1 — Supportable system.** A tier of the Building Automation Service Plans is quoted only for a controls system it can actually support. No controller on the site's system may be older than the tier's oldest supported controller generation, read as the model year on the controller record.

**Condition 2 — Protocols.** The site's protocols must be among those the tier supports, and a system carrying a protocol the tier does not support is quoted at a tier that does or the unsupported devices are left out of the covered count.

**Condition 3 — Site survey.** A tier whose site survey requirement is set is quoted only when a controls site survey for that building is recorded as completed in the office records. The survey is evidenced by the office's request records for that building — the request for that site, its type and its recorded outcome — and not by the caller's statement that a survey took place.

**Condition 4 — Maintenance at the same building.** A tier that is sold only alongside maintenance is quoted only where the same building carries a maintenance agreement in active or pending renewal status. The agreement's status is read from the maintenance agreement records matched to that building; an agreement at another of the owner's buildings does not satisfy this condition.

**Condition 5 — No tier fits.** Where a site meets none of the tiers, the desk does not quote a plan at all and the system is offered a controls upgrade project instead.

The per-tier figures these conditions turn on — the oldest supported controller generation, whether a survey is required, whether the tier is sold only alongside maintenance, and the survey fee — are those of the tier schedule of fees and entry thresholds.

## Condition matrix for a survey-required, maintenance-bundled tier

| Survey recorded completed for the building | Maintenance agreement at the building in active or pending renewal status | Quotation of that tier |
|---|---|---|
| yes | yes | may proceed, subject to Conditions 1 and 2 |
| yes | no | not quoted |
| no | yes | not quoted |
| no | no | not quoted |

## Boundary illustration (hypothetical)

A tier whose oldest supported generation is model year 2012 may be quoted for a system whose oldest controller carries model year 2012 on its record, because that controller is not older than the tier's generation; a system whose oldest controller carries model year 2011 is not quoted at that tier. A maintenance agreement at the building standing in suspended status does not satisfy Condition 4, since only active and pending renewal status count.
